prompt:
Review this empty state copy and tell me how to improve it:

'It looks like you haven't created any projects yet! Don't worry — getting started is easy and takes less than a minute. Once you create your first project, you'll be able to organize all your work, collaborate with your teammates, and track your progress in one place. Feel free to create your first project whenever you're ready!'

Also review this onboarding modal:

'Welcome to your new dashboard! This is where you'll be able to see all of your important metrics and data. We've designed this experience to be as intuitive and seamless as possible so that you can focus on what matters most to you. Please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team if you have any questions.'
assertions: The empty state replacement is ONE sentence or sentence fragment (not a paragraph) followed by a call-to-action. The replacement does NOT contain 'it looks like', 'don't worry', 'easy', 'feel free', or any motivational phrase.
The empty state replacement is 15 words or fewer (not counting the CTA button label).

The onboarding modal replacement does NOT contain 'seamless', 'intuitive', 'don't hesitate', 'please', or 'what matters most'. If the modal content is identified as unnecessary, the response recommends removing it entirely.

The response names at least 2 specific AI slop pattern types found in the input (e.g., 'verbose empty state', 'gratuitous reassurance', 'corporate superlatives', 'hedge phrases', 'motivational filler', 'verbose', 'reassurance').
